'''Arad''' was a famous figure from [[Manetheren]].{{ref/book|c|Arad}}

== Trivia ==
* When [[Mat Cauthon]] exclaims in the [[Old Tongue]] around [[Moiraine Damodred]], she remarks that the blood of [[Aemon]] is still strong in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref/book|1|18}} According to {{c}} and some {{1}} printings{{ref|The 2021 Orbit printing says "Arad."}} Moiraine instead referred to the blood of Arad.{{ref/book|c|Arad}} This makes it highly likely that Arad was a figure of high status in Manetheren, such as one of its kings.
